context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 verified complete Meetings (Görüşlər) module functionality: 1) CRUD operations work via /api/meetings endpoints. 2) Reminders are stored in 'notifications' MongoDB collection with type='reminder' and meeting_id reference. 3) DELETE /api/meetings/{id} also deletes associated notifications. 4) GET /api/notifications includes meeting reminders with severity based on date proximity (high if <=1 day, medium if <=3 days). 5) Frontend has all data-testid attributes for testing. 6) Notification bell shows count and dropdown includes meeting reminders with 'reminder' tag. 7) Online/Offline mode toggle works - shows 'Zoom/Teams linki' placeholder for Online, 'Ünvan' for Offline. 8) All filters (type, department, employee, date range, search) work correctly.

meetings_crud.details: Create, Read, Update, Delete all working. POST/PUT/DELETE /api/meetings/{id}

meetings_reminders.details: Reminders stored in notifications collection. Creating meeting with reminders creates notification entries. Updating reminders recreates notifications. Deleting meeting removes associated notifications.

notifications_integration.details: GET /api/notifications returns meeting reminders with type='reminder', severity based on date proximity, meeting_id reference

notification_bell.details: Bell icon shows count badge (7). Dropdown shows meeting reminders with 'reminder' tag alongside debt notifications

meetings_filters.details: All filters work: meeting_type, department, employee, date_from, date_to, search text

online_offline_mode.details: Toggle works in form. Shows appropriate placeholder (Zoom/Teams link vs Address). Badge displays correctly in table

edit_functionality.details: Edit modal opens with pre-filled data. Shows existing reminders. 'Yadda saxla' (Save) button present

form_dropdowns.details: Employee list from /api/employees, Meeting types from /api/options/all, Departments from /api/options/all
